Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:
Verdict: yes

Across the whole trace (0–30,639.4 ms from its start), **writer (TID 665264)** spent **36.3%** of its time in storage I/O calls—above the 25% threshold. This was mostly `fdatasync` (10,792.6 ms).

The other threads were below the threshold: reader spent 0.008% in storage I/O, and the main `filestore` thread spent 0.0005%; stats and watchdog had no material storage-I/O time.
